channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language, now in Granite 4.1 3B and 8B
item.description: IBM Granite released LLMON, an LLM-native markup language that uses reserved special tokens to explicitly label context structure and offers lossless JSON conversion, alongside experimental 3B and 8B previews built on Granite 4.1. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
item.description: Amplitude says its product agent Wave, roughly 80% powered by OpenAI models including GPT‑6.1 Sol, GPT‑6 Luna and GPT‑Image‑2.5 Flare, cuts product-improvement delivery from about a month to 1–2 days and lifted homepage test-card message volume 160%. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description: Google Search is rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen globally, which VP of Product Robby Stein calls its largest model upgrade yet, letting users ask multi-part questions and get answers with images, tables and links. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen targets fast, cost-efficient agentic workflows with a 1 million-token context priced at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, scoring 51 under default high thinking versus Argon's 50. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Actions for ARM32 Linux & Windows retirement
item.description: GitHub Actions hosted runners will stop ARM32 job execution on Windows and Linux by 8 December 2026, removing native AArch32 user-space support after Node 24 dropped ARM32 following node20's end of support. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Secret scanning detects Cloudflare service tokens
item.description: Secret scanning now automatically detects Cloudflare service tokens as the cloudflare_access_service_token type, reports partner secrets found in public repositories to the issuer, and alerts on user secrets in both public and private repositories. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Holiday Extras is rethinking what it can build with Codex
item.description: Holiday Extras rebuilt its main app with Codex in two weeks instead of over six months, lifting open-to-book conversion 32.5%, cutting errors from 19% to 9% and moving from annual to weekly releases. (OpenAI News)

item.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
item.description: The guide provides fine-tuning scripts and containers for TRELLIS.2 that run locally or on Hugging Face Jobs, and tests whether LoRA can correct the pretrained model's inaccurate shoe soles using 188 footwear objects from GSO. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Public monitoring alerts now have direct links
item.description: GitHub Enterprise Cloud’s Public monitoring view now lets users click any alert number to open that individual alert and use its URL to bookmark the finding or share it with teammates who have access. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: On the Eve of Its IPO Push, Claude's Monthly Visits Hit a Record 1.253 Billion
item.description: Forbes, citing Similarweb, reported Claude reached a record 1.253 billion website visits in October, up 23.8% month over month and ranking 25th globally, while the piece contrasts this with ChatGPT's roughly 6 billion visits and weighs Anthropic's momentum against its scale gap ahead of a planned IPO. (AIbase)

item.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
item.description: Gilbert + Tobin uses ChatGPT Enterprise to build multi-step workflows that reach 87% active usage under human review, freeing lawyers for more human-centered work at the Australian corporate law firm. (OpenAI News)

item.title: A single consumer GPU runs a 60FPS game world: Matrix-Game4.0 lands on Reactor, generating as you play right in the browser
item.description: Kunlun Tech's open-sourced Matrix-Game 4.0 arrives on Reactor, letting browsers generate playable Castle, Ancient Egypt and City Racing worlds at 480p/60 FPS on one RTX 5090, with under-150ms input latency and 18.5 GiB peak VRAM. (AIbase)

item.title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
item.description: OpenAI signed the Charter of Engagement for Safer AI for Children at the Paris Peace Forum and committed $2 million to a scientific research network whose findings, including negative or uncertain results, will be published. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Microsoft relents and lets users turn off Bing AI answers—but there's a toll to pay
item.description: Microsoft's November 11 blog post conceded users want to choose whether AI answers appear in search, yet the opt-out ships as a Microsoft Bing AI Search Choice extension that sets Bing as the default search engine once installed. (AIbase)

item.title: Betting big on tech giants paid off: Dubai billionaire reveals investments in OpenAI, SpaceX and Anthropic raked in billions of dollars.
item.description: Dubai billionaire Hussain Sajwani says his early bets on OpenAI, SpaceX and Anthropic have earned billions of dollars, lifting his net worth above $13 billion, alongside an examination of Anthropic's several-times oversubscribed IPO and valuation concerns. (AIbase)

item.title: AI Office Race Shifts From Model Capability to Cost and Choice: Doubao Work Opens to Third-Party Models
item.description: Doubao Work’s November 12 update adds third-party models Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, with quota-consumption multipliers and limited-time discounts letting users pick by task and cost. (AIbase)

item.title: Grok Bot 1.0 — Bots work together alongside your team
item.description: Grok Bot 1.0's page promises bots that work alongside your team, but the body returns 403 Forbidden and demands JavaScript and cookies, leaving the actual product details unverified. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Claude interactive connectors upgraded: apps can open full-screen alongside the conversation and support direct interaction
item.description: Anthropic's Claude interactive connector upgrade lets tools open full-screen beside the conversation while Claude directly edits pages, table rows or files, with changes shown in real time for confirmation, rolling out to web and desktop across all plans. (AIbase)

item.title: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code — Use Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode (and 6 other harnesses) for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone, and now from the browser with native browser sessions (multi-harness + multi-model) like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
item.description: The open-source free-claude-code project claims 1.3B+ free tokens for running Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode and 9 other harnesses across terminal, app, IDE, phone and new native browser sessions with multi-model, voice support. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Adobe AI Assistant — Create and edit faster with AI across Adobe apps
item.description: Adobe's AI Assistant is billed as speeding up creation and editing across Adobe apps, but the page currently returns only a CAPTCHA security-verification prompt, with no features, figures or examples disclosed. (Product Hunt)
